test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 22 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The practice of intercropping refers to:

options.text: Growing one plant year after year
Growing two or more crops in proximity
Growing different crops at different points of time

solution:
The correct answer is __**Growing two or more crops in proximity**__.
